info.brief: Functions and constants for interacting with the KaiAds SDK.
info.description: Functions and constants for interacting with the KaiAds SDK.

elements.name: kaiads.set_listener
elements.description: Listen to events from the KaiAds SDK.

parameters.name: listener
parameters.doc: function to call when a KaiAds event is received from the SDK.

elements.examples:
local function = on_kaiads_event(self, event, code)
    if event == kaiads.PRELOAD_OK then
        print("KaiAds has successfully preloaded an ad")
    elseif event == kaiads.AD_DISPLAY then
        print("KaiAds is showing an ad")
    elseif event == kaiads.AD_CLOSE then
        print("The user closed the ad!")
    elseif event == kaiads.AD_CLICK then
        print("The user clicked on the ad!")
    else
        print("Something went wrong", code)
    end
end
kaiads.set_listener(on_kaiads_event)

elements.name: kaiads.preload

parameters.name: config
parameters.doc: Ad configuration as a JSON encoded string.

elements.examples:
local banner_config = {
	app = "mygame",
	slot = "menu",
	test = 0,
	timeout = 5 * 1000,
	h = 264,
	w = 240,
	container = "ad-container"
}
kaiads.preload(json.encode(banner_config))

local fullscreen_config = {
	app = "mygame",
	slot = "gameover",
}
kaiads.preload(json.encode(fullscreen_config))

elements.name: kaiads.show
elements.description: Show an ad. You must have called preload() and received a callback that the ad was preloaded before attempting to show an ad.
elements.examples:
kaiads.set_listener(function(self, event, code)
    if event == kaiads.PRELOAD_OK then
        kaiads.show()
    end
end)
kaiads.preload(config)
